description: This file defines the 'Features' interface, which represents a collection of 'Feature' objects associated with a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes methods for managing features such as adding, removing, and retrieving features and their properties, as well as JSON serialization options.

classes.name: Features
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of features, providing methods to manage and serialize a set of 'Feature' objects associated with a 'Thing'.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing an immutable Features instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current features to allow modifications.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves a feature by its ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets or replaces a feature in the collection, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by its ID, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition for a specific feature by ID.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition of a feature by ID.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a feature by ID.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties of a feature by ID.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property within a feature, using a JSON pointer.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property within a feature, using a JSON pointer.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the features collection is semantically null.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no features.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of features for functional processing.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the features to a JSON object, including only non hidden fields.
